intros: I don't want to complain, so here is a quote instead:
Not complaining today. Someone wiser did it better:

quotes.text: Real stupidity beats artificial intelligence every time.
The trouble with having an open mind, of course, is that people will insist on coming along and trying to put things in it.
Light thinks it travels faster than anything but it is wrong. No matter how fast light travels, it finds the darkness has always got there first, and is waiting for it.
Five exclamation marks, the sure sign of an insane mind.
The pen is mightier than the sword if the sword is very short, and the pen is very sharp.
Do you not know that a man is not dead while his name is still spoken?
quotes.by: Terry Pratchett, Going Postal  ·  GNU Terry Pratchett

quotes.text: This palette is beneath me. I require a palette befitting a princess. Something with more sparkle and fewer greys.
quotes.by: in the spirit of Princess Donut (not a real quote)

quotes.text: Carl, the theme changed and you did not even NOTICE. I noticed. I always notice. That is why I am the star.
quotes.by: in the spirit of Princess Donut (not a real quote)
